title: Troubleshoot Event Line Breaking
objectives: Verify the active operational state and explain the evidence.

tasks.instruction: Create application_logs. Before monitoring stack.log on idx01, configure stack_training props.conf: SHOULD_LINEMERGE=true and LINE_BREAKER=([\r\n]+)(?=START). Restart idx01.
Monitor the fixture into application_logs with sourcetype=stack_training. Verify two events, each containing two lines, instead of four separate lines.

hints: Inspect effective configuration and the delivery error before changing a setting.
Creating an index does not add events. Verify the destination, activation and search window independently.

checks.label: application_logs is active on idx01 with the required settings
checks.name: application_logs

checks.label: Search independently confirms the indexed result
checks.search: index=application_logs sourcetype=stack_training | stats count max(linecount) as lines
